# GitHub Copilot repository instructions

Read and follow [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) and [00-ROOT.md](../00-ROOT.md) before substantial SEO/content work.

Use one-source-of-truth governance:
- product facts: `04-PRODUCT-TRUTH.md`;
- claims: `05-CLAIMS-POLICY.md`;
- retailer eligibility: `07-RETAILER-ROUTES.csv`;
- locale URLs: `07-LINKS/sitemap-*.csv`;
- example HTML is never product truth.

For end-to-end worktop assignments, use the `SEO Orchestrator` custom agent.

Never fabricate missing URLs, retailer availability, prices, delivery times, dimensions or sustainability claims.
